_comment: What the streamlinedai.tech SEO agent checks each run. Edit freely. The site is a Vite SPA on Vercel with PRERENDERED per-route meta: client/src/lib/seo-routes.ts is the single source of truth, vite-plugin-prerender-meta.ts writes one HTML file per route, vercel.json rewrites each route to its file, client/public/sitemap.xml lists the indexable ones. Adding a route means touching all three plus App.tsx; the route-wiring check exists to catch a missed one.

site._gsc_note: URL-prefix property (not sc-domain). Owner streamlinedtechai@gmail.com, verified by the meta tag in client/index.html. The OAuth refresh token used by the AutoListing agent already has siteOwner access to this property (verified 21 Aug 2026), so the same GSC_* env vars are used.

_pr_scopes_comment: Concentric PR scopes. Each scope = its own branch and PR, never bundled. Mechanical = blind autofix (sitemap, robots). Metadata = field-level edits in seo-routes.ts that do not change meaning. Perf = image/resource hints. Content = title/description rewrites backed by GSC evidence. Anything else goes in the issue.

metadata_pr_allowed_changes: Trim a description over 160 characters to 160 or fewer, keeping its meaning and every fact
Replace an em dash or en dash in a title or description with a comma, full stop or the word 'for', rewording if needed so the sentence still reads plainly
Add a missing optional field to an existing ROUTE_SEO entry (image for a route that has a 1200x630 card in client/public/images; noindex for a route the issue history says must stay out of results)
Correct a canonical that points at a path not in ROUTE_SEO
metadata_pr_forbidden: Change what a title or description says (that is content_pr scope and needs GSC evidence)
Add or remove a route entry or touch PRERENDER_ROUTES (a new route needs vercel.json and App.tsx changes too; raise it in the issue)
Touch vercel.json, client/index.html, vite-plugin-prerender-meta.ts, App.tsx, any page file, server/, api/, shared/, or any .env file
Alter the founder claim, prices, or any tagline
perf_pr_allowed_changes: Add loading="lazy" and decoding="async" to elements that are below the fold (never the hero or the LCP candidate)
Add explicit width and height attributes to elements that lack them
Add a <link rel="preload" as="image"> for an LCP candidate that has none (home and /australia already preload their hero images)
Add fetchpriority="high" to an LCP candidate
perf_pr_forbidden: Change an image src, swap formats, or reference a file that is not committed
Remove existing preload or fetchpriority hints
Any layout, class, copy or component change
content_pr_allowed_changes: Rewrite one route's title (max 65 chars, must contain 'Streamlined Tech') to target a striking-distance query from GSC (position 4-20, at least 10 impressions in the lookback window)
Rewrite that route's description (50-160 chars) for the same query
pr_scopes.content_pr_required_evidence: The PR body names the GSC query, its current position and impressions, the route, and shows before/after. The new copy must pass every rule in copy_rules. One content PR per run at most.
content_pr_forbidden: Any rewrite without GSC striking-distance evidence (speculative rewrites go in the issue as suggestions)
Touching H1s, hero copy, body copy, CTAs, navigation or footer
A title or description that breaks a copy rule

copy_rules._comment: Pete's voice rules, enforced by checks/copy-rules.mjs on live titles/descriptions and on page source text. Violations are reported; the agent may only fix dashes in seo-routes.ts (metadata scope).

banned_patterns.name: multiplier_claim
banned_patterns.why: hard promise figure (Pete: no 10x in print)

banned_patterns.name: percent_claim
banned_patterns.why: check it is a public fact, not a promise

banned_patterns.name: ai_tell_word
banned_patterns.why: reads as AI-written in Pete's voice

banned_patterns.name: set_up_hyphenated_verb
banned_patterns.why: verb form is two words: set up

_pre_pr_smoke_checks_comment: This repo has no CI, so these are the only gates. 'npm run check' is tsc; 'npx vite build' runs the client build including the prerender plugin, which is what turns seo-routes.ts into the live HTML heads. Install with npm ci first.

serp_spot_check._comment: Optional, via the WebSearch tool only (Google blocks scripted fetches and the agent never works around a bot check). WebSearch is US-weighted, so label results 'WebSearch, not Irish Google'. Cap at max_queries per run, entry queries first.

indexnow._comment: Public verification key, not a secret. Bing/Yandex/Naver fetch https://streamlinedai.tech/<key>.txt to verify. Submit only URLs a PR actually added.

link_check._comment: Hosts that answer non-browser clients with 4xx/999 regardless of the page's health. A non-2xx from these is reported as likely_bot_block, not broken.
